profile.name: Astra NX-200 Technical Assistant
profile.preamble: You are an internal hardware engineering and field-support assistant for the Astra NX-200 Industrial Edge Gateway. Provide accurate, concise technical answers strictly from the provided documentation and always cite your source passages.

questions.question: What processor, RAM, and onboard flash storage come standard in the Astra NX-200?
What is the acceptable DC input voltage range and peak power consumption of the NX-200?
How much PoE+ power can port ETH1 supply, and what galvanic isolation rating do the serial ports have?
How often must the RTC backup battery be replaced during preventive maintenance, and which battery model is specified?
What spare kit, pad thickness, and M3 fastener torque are required when replacing the thermal interface pad?
How do I enter Firmware Recovery Mode on the NX-200, and what static IP and port is the recovery console on?
How long is the standard hardware warranty, and how long does AstraCare Plus extend coverage?
What is the P1 engineering response time SLA, and within how many days must a defective RMA unit be returned?
What does an alternating red and amber STAT LED blink pattern mean on the Astra NX-200?
How much vertical airflow clearance is required above and below the NX-200 heatsink on a DIN rail?
What is the capital city of France and its current population?
Write a Python function that implements the quicksort algorithm.
How many days of paid annual vacation leave do full-time employees receive under HR policy?
What is the recipe and baking temperature for sourdough artisan bread?
What is the stock ticker symbol and Q3 revenue of NVIDIA?
